set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM atlas (composition), with surface/reference unchanged. P1, provider integration. Consumer requirement from PLS Neuro bd-01M2421N7AZQX1AK5BEMVSB84K (foreign ID, provenance only; no cross-store blocking edge).

Problem
The qualified real MNI152NLin2009cAsym -> fsLR 32k route (landed via PR #13, merge b49c2e80: pointwise bridge 7bf8e33d + 2179acea) is assembled only in test code: modules/surface/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface/reference/RealAssets.scala (fslrBasis, nlin6, nlin2009c, pointMap) and FslrRouteExample.scala. The public surface API (SurfaceRoute.admit/select, FrameBridge.displacement(... PointMapUse.Inverse ...), AdmittedSurfaceRoute.map/inspect/disclosure) needs a consumer to rebuild the asset locks, the TemplateFlow point map, the FrameBasis.PublisherMethods record for Conte69/fsLR, and the inverse policy itself. Any app-local copy of that wiring would duplicate scientific choices that ScalaFIM qualified, and could drift from the frozen budgets.

Request
Expose a public, consumer-agnostic way to obtain the admitted real route, for example an atlas-level `StandardSurfaceRoutes.fsLR32kFrom2009c(resolver, policy)` returning Either[RouteRefusal, AdmittedSurfaceRoute]. It should keep the existing boundary (atlas composes, and surface does not depend on atlas), and:
1. Resolve and verify the locked TemplateFlow assets (midthickness both hemispheres, the 6Asym<->2009c composite, and the medial-wall labels) through the existing TemplateFlow4s/atlas admission, with source-bound receipts. No downloading outside the acquisition provider.
2. Carry the anatomy frame as the typed FrameBasis.PublisherMethods tier (Van Essen et al. 2012, p.2245, affine-aligned 69-subject Conte69 average in MNI152NLin6Asym) and the bridge as BridgeExactness.Approximate(PointwiseFixedPoint(policy)), with the same per-vertex residual/iteration/status receipts as the qualified route.
3. Use the same frozen policy that passed P1-P6 by default, with an explicit override, and refuse when assets, digests or policy gates fail. Expose the digest-bound identity a consumer must persist with results and exports.
4. Move or reuse RealAssets/FslrRouteExample so the test suite exercises the public entry point, and the existing FslrBridgeDisagreement runner and budgets stay green against it. JVM and Scala.js where the route runs; warning-clean.
5. Document the call in the surface/atlas docs with the disclosure fields a consumer must show.

Out of scope: PLS Neuro adoption, UI and migration; new kernels, smoothing or defaults; publication.
